explanation: Completing the square gives 6(x-1)^2-4(y-1)^2-6z^2=12. One positive squared term and two negative squared terms equal a positive constant, so this is a hyperboloid of two sheets centered at (1,1,0).

answers.correct_value: A hyperboloid of two sheets centered at $(1,1,0)$
answers.wrong_value: A hyperboloid of one sheet centered at $(1,1,0)$
